name: 110 ~Sanfujinka Shikeishuu Byouin Jack~
original_name: 110 ～産婦人科 死刑囚 病院ジャック～
source: Dokumamushi Kisuke is a criminal on death row that has committed 20 crimes. During a police transfer, he managed to escape and in the process stole a gun from a policeman. On the run from the police and looking for a place to hide he comes to a women's health hospital. Without thinking he decides to take refuge in the hospital leading to the nurses and patients becoming his hostages. Now let the terror and rape fest begin.
